title: 5-Minute Breath Prayer — Homeward

blocks.label: Text: A five-minute practice
Heading: Breath Prayer
Text: Breathing in, I receive peace. Breathing out, I offer love.
blocks.value: Breathing in, I receive peace. Breathing out, I offer love.

blocks.label: Text: Five quiet minutes
Heading: Let the breath carry the prayer.
blocks.value: Let the breath carry the prayer.

blocks.value: Sit in a comfortable position. Let your breathing be natural. There is no need to make the breath deep or slow. When your attention wanders, return gently to the next breath.

blocks.label: Button / link: Begin
Button / link: Pause

Text: How to practice
Heading: A simple rhythm.
Text: Feel the support of the chair and the ground beneath you.
blocks.value: Feel the support of the chair and the ground beneath you.

blocks.label: Text: Allow the breath to come and go naturally.
blocks.value: Allow the breath to come and go naturally.

blocks.label: Text: When thoughts come, notice them without criticism and return to the pray…
blocks.value: When thoughts come, notice them without criticism and return to the prayer.

blocks.label: Text: At the end, sit quietly for one more breath before moving.
blocks.value: At the end, sit quietly for one more breath before moving.

blocks.label: Text: Carry it with you
Heading: One conscious breath can become a doorway.
blocks.value: One conscious breath can become a doorway.
